reference: He has checked six sources tonight, and the pile is still growing.
sk: Dnes v noci preveril už šesť zdrojov a kopa stále rastie.
cz: Dnes v noci prověřil už šest zdrojů a hromada pořád roste.
acceptable: He has {already |}{checked|verified|gone through} six sources tonight, and the {pile|stack|heap} {is still growing|keeps growing}.
He has {checked|verified|gone through} six sources {already tonight|tonight already}, and the {pile|stack|heap} {is still growing|keeps growing}.
Tonight he has {already |}{checked|verified|gone through} six sources, and the {pile|stack|heap} {is still growing|keeps growing}.

mistakes.text: He {checked|verified} six sources tonight, and the pile is still growing.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Obdobie „tonight“ ešte neskončilo, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Období „tonight“ ještě neskončilo, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “tonight” is not over yet, so Present Perfect is better: “has checked”.

mistakes.text: He has been {checking|verifying} six sources tonight, and the pile is still growing.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („six sources“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has checked“, nie „has been checking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U počtu hotových dějů („six sources“) patří Present Perfect Simple: „has checked“, ne „has been checking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“six sources”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has checked”, not “has been checking”.

mistakes.text: He has {checked|verified} six sources this night, and the pile is still growing.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Dnes v noci“ je po anglicky „tonight“, nie „this night“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Dnes v noci“ je anglicky „tonight“, ne „this night“.

mistakes.text: He has {checked|verified} six sources tonight, and the pile still grows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Zmena, ktorá práve prebieha, patrí do Present Continuous: „is still growing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Změna, která právě probíhá, patří do Present Continuous: „is still growing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A change happening right now needs Present Continuous: “is still growing”.
